title: EQWE-AgriNet: Rice Leaf Disease Classification
description: An explainable, reliability-weighted ensemble of CNN and transformer models that classifies rice leaf diseases. It uses calibrated confidence, Grad-CAM explanations and a reject option that sends uncertain images to an expert.

title: BangLish Compiler
description: A browser-based toy compiler for a Bangla-English (BangLish) programming language. It includes a code editor, tokenizer, parser and output console, all written in HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

title: Personal Portfolio Website
description: This multi-page website. Built with HTML5, CSS3, jQuery and AJAX, it loads projects from a JSON file and uses a validated contact form. It is hosted on Netlify.

title: Database Programming Practice
description: Designed relational tables and wrote SQL queries (joins, grouping and sub-queries) in MySQL while completing the BTEB Database Programming course.
